name: Okayu Nyumu! R
source:
Nekomata Okayu—the charming face of an onigiri shop, now in human form.

You two have shared a life of joy and smiles ever since falling in love. But when an invitation to a Tokyo food fair arrives, you find yourself stuck on a new recipe. Seeing this, Okayu smiles and says:

"Then how about a trip to Aomori with me? We can go scouting for all the tasty ideas out there! ♪"

This "business trip" quickly transforms into a "lovers' vacation." A bond that started like a prank from the gods becomes deeper and dearer with every stop along the way.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4580450/R_OkayunyumuR/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
猫又小粥——化为人形的饭团店迷人看板娘。

自坠入爱河以来，你们二人一直过着充满欢声笑语的甜蜜生活。然而当一封东京美食展的邀请函寄到手中时，你却在研发新食谱上陷入了瓶颈。见此情景，小粥微笑着提议道：

“那不如和我一起去青森旅行吧？我们可以一路搜罗各种美味灵感呀！♪”

这场“公务出差”很快变成了一趟“恋人度假之旅”。这段始于神明恶作剧般的羁绊，随着旅途中的每一站驻足而愈发深厚珍贵。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4580450/R_OkayunyumuR/]Steam[/url]]
